na7f350162e.headline: Centeno reviews Costa's accounts. Government spends half of what was planned on 'lay-off'
na7f350162e.summary: Portugal's government has spent only half of the planned funds on lay-off schemes, with rejected requests, dismissals, and bankruptcies contributing to lower spending.
na7f350162e.why: Lay-off schemes are key to labor market stability; underspending may indicate economic distress and rising unemployment risks.
